title: Swiss thatched cottage (NYPL b11708027-G91F174 092F)
blurb: * One view has advertising recruiting agents to sell stereos and other items. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. Views in Prospect Park: gardens, greenhouses, lakes, the reservoir, gazebos, the "dairy," boat landing and boats, waterfalls, arbors, bridges, Litchfield "castle," arches, the thatched cottage, concert grove house, drinking fountains, "boiler house," plaza fountain at Grand Army Plaza, statues of Abraham Lincoln, John Howard Payne and Washington Irving, Brooklyn from the park, clearing snow, and group portraits and views of people enjoying the park. Hand-colored photoprints. Includes nine hand-colored views. Includes views by Anthony, J. W. & J. S. Moulton, S. B. Nicols and other photographers and publishers.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.17% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.44% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
